description: Explain the signed-in person's collection: its current value, cost and profit, the standout coins, how complete each coin series is, how the value changed over time, or what it held day by day in a period. A missing price is reported as missing, never estimated.

cursor.description: With view=completeness: next_cursor of the previous page, with the same other arguments.
cursor.title: Cursor

end.description: With view=history: last day, YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future. Omitted = today.
end.title: End

max_points.description: With view=growth or history: upper bound of points; a longer series is thinned evenly.
max_points.title: Max Points

series_id.description: With view=completeness: list every coin of this one series with its status, instead of the table of series. The id comes from get_catalog_entity.
series_id.title: Series Id

start.description: With view=history: first day, YYYY-MM-DD. Omitted = 89 days before end.
start.title: Start

view.description: summary = what the collection is worth now, what was paid and the profit; statistics = the most valuable coin, the biggest gain and loss, the first purchase; completeness = how full every coin series is; growth = how the value changed over time, by purchase dates; history = what the collection actually held and was worth on each day of a period, as recorded day by day.
view.title: View

name: get_collection_analytics
title: Collection analytics
